/*
    Inclusion of CUST_CIF_NBR (CIF) -> This will be used to JOIN in CI_DEMOGRAPHIC
*/
SELECT
    TXN.*
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TXN.TXN_CODE) SK --- Additional
    ,CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS FCBSCIF
/*
    Remove the duplicates using ROW_NUMBER() window function
*/
FROM (
SELECT
    *
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TXN_ACCT_NBR, TXN_CARD_NBR, TXN_CODE, TXN_POSTING_DTE, TXN_AUTH_CODE, TXN_ACQ_REF, TXN_BATCH_SEQ
        ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) DESC) RN
    FROM eds.CCD_CBCEXCTDBP_CI_20240618 TXN
    ---WHERE CAST(CAST(TXN_DTE AS char(8)) AS date) >= '2024-04-01'
) TXN
/*
    Link all customers associated to the account of the transaction using AAS
    Fetch the ORGKEY in CUSTOMER_DIM
*/
INNER JOIN
    (SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR FROM eds.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT_CI_20240618 GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR) CCD
    ON TXN.TXN_ACCT_NBR = CCD.CRDACCT_NBR
    AND TXN.TXN_CARD_NBR = CCD.CARD_NBR
    AND CAST(CAST(TXN_DTE AS char(8)) AS date) = CAST(CCD.AS_OF_DATE AS DATE)
WHERE RN = 1 AND CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR IS NOT NULL
